name: Black Sea Rim Current
scope: One declared counterclockwise Black Sea basin-margin reference circuit under the surface geostrophic circulation convention. An arbitrary western anchor closes the path; it is not a current origin or termination. Excludes the interior Western/Eastern gyres, coastal eddy loops and branch sums. Historical Caucasus and Southern Current naming equivalence remains unresolved.
layer: Surface geostrophic circulation context; source drifters have mixed near-surface support through the first 15 m, with wind-driven components estimated separately. No uniform full-depth axis inferred.
time_convention: Editorial closed-circuit geography in the context of the source 1999-2009 surface geostrophic statistics. Vertices are not extracted from the mean field or any dated frame. Closure does not establish continuous seasonal flow, parcel circulation time or annual extrema.
source_locator: Introduction; Section 2; Sections 3.1 and 3.2.1: surface geostrophic context, seasonal anomalies and Rim circuit around interior gyres.
source_citation: Menna and Poulain (2014), Geostrophic currents and kinetic energies in the Black Sea estimated from merged drifter and satellite altimetry data, Ocean Science 10, 155-165, doi:10.5194/os-10-155-2014.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices around the Anatolian, Caucasus and Crimean basin-margin neighborhoods. The northern path skirts south of Crimea and omits interior gyre circuits. Alternatives vary detour shape without tracing source velocity arrows or a particular isobath. No source field digitized. Closed path length counts every leg once, including the closing leg. A declared offshore bend around the Sinop coastal protrusion prevents a straight southern chord crossing the coarse land shape; the bend is not a measured jet meander.

alternative_routes.interpretation: More interior editorial circuit with shorter peripheral detours; not a seasonal flow or inner current edge.
More peripheral editorial detours under the same basin-margin convention; not an observed isobath or outer current edge.

scenario_rule: Three explicitly closed counterclockwise circuit shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: nine editorial scenarios. Independent endpoint shifts fixed at zero to preserve closure. Alternatives are not seasonal footprints, widths or confidence limits.
